provenance: reconstructed from waldzellai/agent-toolkit schema.py (15 core tools) + stripe DXT manifest.json tool names + Stripe MCP docs for extended set. mcp.stripe.com serves schemas dynamically at runtime; static schemas unavailable without credentials. Verify against live endpoint before publishing figures.

tools.name: search_documentation
tools.description: Search Stripe's documentation for guides, API references, and best practices to answer integration questions.

question.description: The user question about integrating with Stripe.

language.description: The programming language to filter documentation results (e.g. 'python', 'node', 'ruby').

tools.name: create_customer
tools.description: Create a customer in Stripe.

tools.name: list_customers
tools.description: List customers in Stripe, optionally filtered by email.

limit.description: A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100.

email.description: A case-sensitive filter on the list based on the customer's email field.

tools.name: create_product
tools.description: Create a product in Stripe.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List products in Stripe.

limit.description: A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 10.

tools.name: create_price
tools.description: Create a price for a product in Stripe.

product.description: The ID of the product to create the price for.

unit_amount.description: The unit amount of the price in cents.

currency.description: The currency of the price (three-letter ISO code, e.g. 'usd').

tools.name: list_prices
tools.description: List prices in Stripe, optionally filtered by product.

product.description: The ID of the product to list prices for.

limit.description: A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 10.

tools.name: create_payment_link
tools.description: Create a payment link in Stripe.

price.description: The ID of the price to create the payment link for.

quantity.description: The quantity of the product to include in the payment link.

tools.name: create_invoice
tools.description: Create an invoice in Stripe.

customer.description: The ID of the customer to create the invoice for.

days_until_due.description: The number of days until the invoice is due.

tools.name: list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices in Stripe, optionally filtered by customer.

customer.description: The ID of the customer to list invoices for.

limit.description: A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 10.

tools.name: create_invoice_item
tools.description: Create an invoice item and attach it to an invoice in Stripe.

customer.description: The ID of the customer to create the invoice item for.

price.description: The ID of the price for the item.

invoice.description: The ID of the invoice to create the item for.

tools.name: finalize_invoice
tools.description: Finalize an invoice in Stripe (moves it from draft to open status).

invoice.description: The ID of the invoice to finalize.

tools.name: retrieve_balance
tools.description: Retrieve the balance for the Stripe account.

tools.name: create_refund
tools.description: Refund a payment intent in Stripe.

payment_intent.description: The ID of the PaymentIntent to refund.

amount.description: The amount to refund in cents. If omitted, the full amount is refunded.

tools.name: list_payment_intents
tools.description: List payment intents in Stripe, optionally filtered by customer.

customer.description: The ID of the customer to list payment intents for.

limit.description: A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100.

tools.name: list_subscriptions
tools.description: List subscriptions in Stripe, optionally filtered by customer, price, or status.

customer.description: The ID of the customer to list subscriptions for.

limit.description: A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100.

tools.name: cancel_subscription
tools.description: Cancel a subscription in Stripe.

subscription.description: The ID of the subscription to cancel.

tools.name: update_subscription
tools.description: Update an existing subscription in Stripe (e.g. change plan, quantity, or proration behavior).

subscription.description: The ID of the subscription to update.

proration_behavior.description: Determines how to handle prorations when changing a subscription.

items.description: A list of subscription items to update, add, or remove.

price.description: The price ID to switch to.

deleted.description: Set to true to delete this subscription item.

tools.name: list_coupons
tools.description: List coupons in Stripe.

limit.description: A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100.

tools.name: create_coupon
tools.description: Create a coupon in Stripe.

name.description: Name of the coupon displayed to customers on invoices or receipts.

percent_off.description: A positive float (0-100) that gives the percentage discount.

amount_off.description: Amount in cents to subtract from an invoice total.

currency.description: Three-letter ISO currency code. Required when amount_off is set.

duration.description: Specifies how long the discount will be in effect.

duration_in_months.description: Required only if duration is 'repeating'. The number of months the coupon applies.

tools.name: update_dispute
tools.description: Update a dispute in Stripe with evidence.

dispute.description: The ID of the dispute to update.

evidence.description: Evidence to upload to respond to a dispute. Mirrors the Stripe dispute evidence object.

cancellation_policy_disclosure.description: An explanation of how and when the customer was shown the cancellation policy.

cancellation_rebuttal.description: A justification for why the customer's subscription was not canceled.

customer_communication.description: ID of a file upload showing communication with the customer.

customer_email_address.description: The email address of the customer.

customer_purchase_ip.description: The IP address that the customer used when making the purchase.

duplicate_charge_explanation.description: An explanation of the difference between the disputed charge and prior charge.

product_description.description: A description of the product or service sold.

receipt.description: ID of a file upload of the receipt.

refund_policy.description: ID of a file upload of the refund policy.

refund_policy_disclosure.description: Documentation demonstrating that the customer was shown the refund policy.

refund_refusal_explanation.description: A justification for why the customer is not entitled to a refund.

service_date.description: The date on which the customer received or began receiving the purchased service.

service_documentation.description: ID of a file upload of documentation showing the customer was provided the service.

shipping_address.description: The address to which a physical product was shipped.

shipping_documentation.description: ID of a file upload of documentation showing shipment.

submit.description: Whether to immediately submit evidence to the bank. If false, evidence is staged on the dispute.

tools.name: list_disputes
tools.description: List disputes in Stripe, optionally filtered by charge or payment intent.

limit.description: A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100.

tools.name: get_stripe_account_info
tools.description: Retrieve high-level information about the connected Stripe account.
